r026_p1.why: The NEXT recount's 67 misses three opening spawns: its first readable queue is at 135.30, but fr/x/a1.png shows Z spawned and was held at 134.9 (queue ZLTOJ->LTOJI), L spawned 135.0 and locked 135.2 (score 0->38), T spawned 135.3 and was held with Z coming out and locking ~135.45 (38->72), O spawned 135.6 (the tool's first shift). So the queue gave out 68+3 = 71 pieces. The piece left in hold at the KO (a T) never locked, which leaves 70 locks. Re-running nextcount over 150.0-156.5 gives 12 single shifts in 151.4-155.6 (151.47, 151.83, 152.00, 152.23, 152.57, 152.73, 153.00, 153.37, 153.50, 153.73, 154.20, 155.43) with only holds in between, so b2's 12 locks there are confirmed. The last T (spawned 164.97) is turned into its slot and locks with a flash at 165.33, the KO frame (fr/x/a3.png; the score jumps +3600 at 165.43), so it counts. Both counts already include it. The table's 70 stands.

r009_p2.why: The game opens with J spawning and going straight into the empty hold at 85.67 (fr/x/b1.png: the queue drops J, O moves to the top), a spawn the recount missed because its first read is at 85.70. With it, the queue gave out 29+1 = 30 pieces. The chain's 30 events include that 85.67 event as a lock, and it is not one (the chain notes 'no hold-into-empty seen'). At the end (fr/x/b2.png) J locks 97.4, I spawns 97.57 and is held at 97.63, and the T that comes out locks ~98.27 (score 14810->20210 at 98.33). Nothing else spawns before the KO at 98.53, and I is in hold, unlocked. 30 spawns less the I left in hold = 29 locks: the chain's events 85.80..97.57. The recount's 28 also wrongly dropped the last spawn, which as the T did lock. Aside: the 97.57 chain event is typed 'double', but the +5400 jump (TSD with B2B) and the T in its slot say it is a tsd.
